newsitem.title: CHINA: Series of disasters kill 34 in China province.
newsitem.headline: Series of disasters kill 34 in China province.

text.p: Gales, floods, hail and landslides have devastated three counties in China's southwestern Yunnan province, killing 34 people and injuring 281, the People's Daily Overseas Edition said on Wednesday.
The series of disasters on June 4 and 5 in the Yunnan counties of Yiliang, Yongshan and Daguan affected 115,720 people and damaged 37,456 homes, the newspaper said.
The disasters affected 13,440 hectares (33,211 acres) of farmland, it said but gave no details of economic losses.
Rescue work in the stricken areas was under way, it said.
A official in neighbouring Sichuan province said on Tuesday that a huge landslide triggered by torrential rains had killed at least three people and left 147 missing.
The landslide crashed down on four villages in Sichuan's Meigu county early on June 5, burying residents as they slept, the official said by telephone from the provincial capital, Chengdu.
A night of torrential rain and hailstorms in the mountainous area triggered the landslide, officials and media reports said.
The disaster affected 1,527 people in the area and left two seriously injured, the Sichuan official said.
The death toll could rise to as high as 110 after bodies of the missing were recovered, the Yangcheng Evening News said in an edition available in Beijing on Tuesday.
